UserProgress.title: UserProgress
UserProgress.description: Persists a student's completed lessons, read status, passed exercises, and assessment scores.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the student owner.

completedLessons.description: Ordered list of completed lesson IDs (max 100).

readLessons.description: List of lesson IDs marked as read (max 100).

passedExercises.description: List of lesson IDs whose hands-on exercise passed verification (max 100).

quizScores.description: Map of lessonId to highest assessment percentage score (0-100).

progressEpoch.description: Baseline progress epoch identifier used to detect one-time account progress resets.

completionDates.description: Bounded list of unique YYYY-MM-DD local calendar dates on which the student completed at least one lesson (max 366).

gameHighScores.description: Map of chapterId to best Chapter Recap Game percentage score (0-100, max 50 entries).

activeLessonId.description: Lesson ID the student was most recently working on.

selectedLanguageId.description: Track/language ID currently selected in the roadmap.

lastView.description: Last active workspace view so returning students resume where they stopped.

activeLessonTab.description: Active tab within the current lesson (learn, practice, or assessment).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the user progress record was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest progress update.

EarnedToken.title: EarnedToken
EarnedToken.description: Represents an engraved digital badge token minted upon completing a curriculum lesson.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the student who earned this token.

lessonId.description: Curriculum lesson ID linked to this token.

tokenCode.description: Deterministic serial code (e.g. CP-01 through CP-70).

languageId.description: Curriculum track identifier (html, css, javascript, react, backend).

order.description: 1-based sequential index of the lesson token in the curriculum.

earnedAt.description: Server timestamp when the digital token was minted.

EarnedAchievement.title: EarnedAchievement
EarnedAchievement.description: Milestone achievement badge unlocked upon completing a module, lesson series, streak, or chapter recap game.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the student who earned this milestone.

earnedAt.description: Server timestamp when the milestone badge was unlocked.

/users/{userId}.description: Stores each student's curriculum progress keyed by their Firebase Auth UID.

/users/{userId}/tokens/{tokenId}.description: Stores digital tokens earned by the student for completed lessons, keyed by lessonId.

/users/{userId}/achievements/{achievemen.description: Stores milestone achievement badges unlocked by the student for module, series, streak, and game completions.
